root_cause_hypothesis: The invoice was submitted without a purchase order number. This may be because the buyer made a purchase without following the standard procurement process or the vendor omitted the number upon submission.
recommended_action: Contact the business requestor or vendor to obtain the correct PO number or secure approval for a non-PO invoice.
communication_draft:
Hi there,

A quick heads-up from the AP team. We have received an invoice that requires your urgent attention as it is missing a Purchase Order.

Vendor: US Supplier
Invoice ID: INV-US-001
Amount: $1000.00

As per our policy, this payment is currently on hold and cannot be processed until a valid PO is raised and approved.

To ensure timely payment to the vendor and remain compliant, please raise the PO for this expense within the next 3 business days.

Let us know if you have any questions. Thanks for your prompt help
